event_chain.summary: Unusual network activity; employee data possibly accessed

summary: On June 5, 2026 McClarty Farms LLC, an agricultural operation in Kingsburg, California, detected unusual activity on its computer network. An investigation with outside experts, concluded June 23, found that employee personal information could have been accessed or downloaded. The company notified affected employees on July 10 and offered credit monitoring; the number affected was not disclosed.
